body:
## Problem

Categories are free-text strings on items (`item.category`) plus a partial,
list-level order array (`category_order`). Both clients group **case-sensitively**
— web keys buckets on the exact trimmed string (`grouping.ts`), Android on
`it.category.value` (`ListViewModel.groupByCategory`). So an item in "Group" and
an item in "group" render as two separate categories.

Web then force-uppercases the header (`ListPage.tsx`, `textTransform: uppercase`),
so the two collapse into two identical-looking "GROUP"s — reads as a duplicate.
The app shows raw casing, so the two are distinguishable but still two groups.

There is no way to fix a category's casing anywhere: `category_order` is only the
categories the user explicitly ordered (others sort in after), and neither client
has a rename.

Reported by the user. Entirely client-side — no server/schema involvement.

## Design (agreed)

1. **Case-insensitive grouping (merge).** Key buckets by `lower(trim(category))`
   on BOTH clients. Collapses "Group"/"group" into one group everywhere.

2. **Canonical display name per group.** Resolve the bucket's shown casing as:
   the case-insensitively-matching `category_order` entry's casing if present,
   else a deterministic fallback = most-frequent casing among the bucket's items,
   lexicographic tiebreak. Deterministic so both clients agree without
   coordinating; self-heals during sync.

3. **List settings = the place to fix casing/order.** Today the panel
   (`ListPropsPage.tsx` / android `ui/listprops/ListPropsScreen.kt`) shows only
   `category_order` entries. Change it to show the **full category set**
   (items ∪ category_order), each reorderable AND renameable/recaseable.
   - Recasing/renaming **rewrites the affected items' `category`** to the new
     canonical string (bounded bulk LWW: all items whose `lower(category)`
     matches), AND updates the `category_order` entry's casing/position. This
     actually normalizes the data so every surface (both clients, registry,
     exports) shows the fix — not a display-only alias.
   - LWW note: those item writes beat a concurrent edit to the same item's
     category by timestamp. Acceptable for a deliberate, rare normalization;
     call it out in the impl.

4. **Drop web's uppercase header.** Remove the `textTransform: uppercase` on the
   category `<h2>` (`ListPage.tsx`) so the user's canonical casing is actually
   visible on web (today every header is UPPERCASE regardless). Android already
   shows raw casing.

5. **Category autocomplete on web, matching Android.** Android's item form shows a
   row of clickable `AssistChip`s of existing categories below the text field,
   filtered to those containing the typed text (case-insensitive) and not equal to
   it, click to fill (`ui/item/ItemFormFields.kt`, sourced from
   `ItemsRepo.distinctCategories`). Add the same UI to the web item dialog
   (`components/ItemDialog.tsx`): clickable chips/buttons of the existing
   categories, same filter rule, click to set the field.
   - Suggestion source becomes the **canonical (case-insensitively-distinct)**
     category set on BOTH clients, so we never offer "Group" and "group"
     separately. On Android that means `distinctCategories` (Room query in
     `data/db/Daos.kt` via `ItemsRepo`) must dedup case-insensitively and return
     canonical casing; on web, derive from the same canonicalization used for
     grouping. This also doubles as prevention — users stop minting new
     case-variants.

## Constraints

- Client-only: no server or schema change. `category_order` and `item.category`
  are existing synced fields.
- Must be implemented **identically** on both clients (the grouping key and the
  canonical-name rule) or they'll disagree on casing. Add a spec line to
  `docs/superpowers/specs/client-ui-notes.md` defining both, as the single source
  of truth.

## Files (indicative)

- web: `lib/grouping.ts` (case-insensitive key + canonical name; likely a small
  shared canonicalization helper), `pages/ListPage.tsx` (drop uppercase),
  `pages/ListPropsPage.tsx` (full-set + rename/recase + item rewrite),
  `components/ItemDialog.tsx` (category chips).
- android: `ui/list/ListViewModel.kt` (`groupByCategory` case-insensitive +
  canonical name), `ui/listprops/ListPropsScreen.kt` + `ListPropsViewModel.kt`
  (rename/recase + item rewrite), `ui/item/ItemFormViewModel.kt` +
  `data/repo/ItemsRepo.kt` + `data/db/Daos.kt` (`distinctCategories` →
  case-insensitive-distinct canonical set).
- docs: `client-ui-notes.md` (grouping key + canonical-name rule).
- server: none.

## Suggested breakdown when picked up
1. Shared canonicalization rule + case-insensitive grouping on both clients +
   drop web uppercase (the visible "merge" fix).
2. Rename/recase in list settings on both clients, rewriting item categories.
3. Web category autocomplete chips (+ make distinctCategories canonical on both).

Not started — filed for a future batch.
title: Categories: case-insensitive merge, central casing fix, drop web uppercase, web category autocomplete
